title: Guides and materials
changes: A new page at /resources offering the kits Zikaron BaSalon publishes: the hosting kit with its Yad Vashem booklet, the kit for families giving testimony, the teacher's guide, the Our Stories session plan, the texts for discussion, and an example story-building deck.
Searchable and filtered by the organisation's own categories — hosts, those giving testimony, ready-made sessions, discussion, education.
Open without an account, like the example stories: someone deciding whether to host an evening should be able to read what hosting involves first.
The documents stay in Hebrew as published. They are the organisation's, not the Studio's, and the page says so and links back to their library.
